Sam (Product): Quick: pilot customers want cost estimates per-request, drift alerts on prompt-sets, and an optional quant beta. Need a clear Q3 pilot slice.
Eve (Eng): My vote: prioritize adaptive batching + prefix cache. Cost estimator is low lift. Quant is risky.
Luca (Data): Usage: 65% short repeats, 25% long batch jobs. Cache benefits many tenants; batching helps long jobs.
Rina (ML): If we touch quant, require eval gating + canary fallback to fp16. We'll need automated similarity checks.
Devon (Sales): Two customers will pilot batching+cache; one will join a quant beta if we guarantee <1% quality drop on their prompts.
Kai (SRE): Ops checklist: RBAC for prompt uploads, cache eviction metrics, rollback playbook.
Sam (Product): Proposed pilot MVP: (1) cost estimator (server-side, conservative) (2) adaptive batching (config knobs) (3) prefix KV cache w/ TTL and opt-out (4) eval-triggered alerts for customer prompt-sets. Quant = opt-in beta.
Eve (Eng): Est: estimator 1wk, batching+cache 4-6wks, alerts 2-3wks, quant gating 3-4wks.
Luca (Data): For alerts we'll use embedding-sim, token-shift, and a small human audit sample to keep FP noise <5%.
Sam (Product): Launch criteria draft: >=12% median token-cost reduction for pilot tenants over 30d, false-positive alert rate <5% on sample, <=1% degradation on key prompts.
Devon (Sales): I'll lock pilot customers and ask for agreement on the 30d measurement window.
Rina (ML): Canary plan for quant: unit tests -> offline eval -> 1% canary -> 24-48h monitoring -> rollback if similarity drops.
Kai (SRE): I'll draft the rollback runbook and per-tenant cache throttle design.
Sam (Product): Action items: @Eve perf sims + config mock, @Luca detector thresholds, @Rina quant gating doc, @Devon customer signups, @Kai ops runbook. We'll present pilot slice to leadership on Friday.
